summary.text: Karen Hamilton is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 62, which covers Greene and Madison counties and parts of Culpeper and Orange counties.
Karen Hamilton has been a member since January 14, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Karen Hamilton was born in Virginia.
Karen Hamilton studied at UNC Charlotte (B.S., Civil Engineering, 2007).
Karen Hamilton's listed occupation is small business owner.
The profile lists military service as "Military Spouse, Navy 2005-2015."
Karen Hamilton's listed memberships and affiliations include Moms for America (Orange County leader) and the Orange County GOP (former treasurer).
The profile lists Cameron Hamilton as Karen Hamilton's spouse.
The House profile lists Karen Hamilton's committee assignments as Communications, Technology and Innovation and Public Safety.
